# Contributor Terms

By contributing to repositories seeded from `mergetonic/common`, you confirm:

- You have the right to submit the contribution.
- You grant project maintainers the rights required to use, modify, and distribute your contribution under the repository license.
- You understand your acceptance is recorded in `common/.github/contributor-acceptance.json`.

## Acceptance Semantics

- Acceptance is tied to your GitHub login.
- Acceptance covers both contributor terms and license terms for the active `policy_version`.
- A PR is considered compliant only when every contributor in its commit graph has an active acceptance record.

## Revocation and Updates

- Maintainers may mark records inactive when required.
- New policy versions may require re-acceptance.
- Acceptance operations are auditable through commits and pull requests.
